verdict.rationale: BVNK documents per-customer virtual accounts in USD, EUR and GBP. It also offers wallets created against a customer ID and reference, channels (persistent, never-changing deposit addresses), and a unique blockchain address for every payment, plus a webhook when a channel transaction is confirmed. That covers the core of dedicated, attributable deposit endpoints, but the docs never show that incoming pay-ins carry customer attribution that removes manual matching. missing for 10: explicit documentation that virtual accounts are named per customer, pay-in or webhook payloads showing the customer or reference attached to incoming funds, independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic reconciliation.

support.subject: As a developer, incoming funds are attributable — named virtual accounts or dedicated deposit addresses per customer so reconciliation knows who paid without manual matching

citations.quote: Create virtual accounts in USD, EUR, GBP for your business or customers.
A channel is a unique, repeated-use blockchain address that can receive crypto or stablecoins at any time. The address never changes.
Specify a customer's ID and reference to create wallets for them
BVNK generates a live quote to be accepted by the customer and a unique blockchain address for the payment to be made to.
triggered when a new channel transaction is confirmed on chain, and the transaction has been processed.
